name: WARNING: Sushi Bar Crispy Salmon Skin Roll (Sharp Fried Scales & Connective Grit)
whyItWorks: Salmon skin broiled or deep-fried until brittle and shatteringly crisp. The sharp, jagged charred skin fragments and residual scale grit resist enzymatic breakdown and physically abrade the delicate intestinal lining.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order fresh salmon flesh (Sake nigiri) instead of crispy fried skin.
